The Ogarus story

Nearly three decades of combined experience.

Founded by Clint Nell and Blessing Tarugarira, Ogarus brings together extensive local and international experience across technology infrastructure, residential construction and commercial spaces.

Our approach is straightforward: understand the property, plan the work properly and deliver a result that performs for years—not only on handover day.

Construction division

Your project.
Our building expertise.

Ogarus is appointed as the construction partner to build, renovate, repair or improve a property owned or commissioned by the client.

The clear distinction

Construction begins
with your project.

You bring the property, land, approved plan or defined scope. Ogarus brings the construction team, trade coordination and quality control required to execute it properly.

This division is for client-led building work. It does not include Ogarus originating or developing the property opportunity itself.

Property Investments

Invest where construction
creates value.

Focused acquisition and partnership opportunities built around high-potential Cape Town properties valued between R3 million and R5 million.

The investment model

Construction insight.
Investment discipline.

Ogarus identifies properties where strategic renovation can unlock measurable value. Our construction knowledge allows us to assess the real scope, control improvement costs and make more informed property decisions.

This division focuses on acquisitions, equity partnerships and joint ventures—not general property development.

Property Development

From opportunity
to completed asset.

End-to-end residential and commercial property development—from feasibility and planning through construction and final delivery.

The development division

Developed with purpose.
Built for long-term value.

Property development is a separate service for clients, landowners and partners who want to create new property assets. Ogarus coordinates the journey from the initial opportunity through design, approvals, construction and handover.

Whether it is a custom residential development, a small multi-unit project or a commercial opportunity, every decision is guided by usability, build quality and end value.
